notes: Short text scenes. Each is shown once in a game, the first time the thing happens, and the game stands still while it is up.
enemy: the first living beast you see. skeleton: the first walking skeleton. walking_dead: the first other dead thing that walks.
body: the first human remains you see. water: the first water you come to. secret: the first hidden room you get into.
The words are the player's own thoughts, in the voice of the opening journal. Keep them plain. {name} is the creature's name.
A level can name hidden rooms that have no false wall: "scenes": [{ "id": "secret", "area": [x0, z0, x1, z1] }] (cells, both ends included).
hub_note: the surveyor's note beside the spare knapsack in the great hall. Any scene named in a level's "scenes" areas is shown once, the first time you walk into the area.

enemy.title: Something alive
lines: Something moved at the edge of my light.
It is a {name}. It has seen me, and it is not afraid of me.
This tomb was shut for three thousand years. Nothing should be living in it.
Nobody is coming to help me. I will have to kill it, or get away from it.

skeleton.title: The bones are standing
lines: There is a skeleton standing ahead of me. It is holding a spear.
I took it for a burial propped against the wall. Then it turned its head and looked at me.
There is no flesh on it, and nothing to hold the bones together. It is walking toward me all the same.
I have dug up the dead for eleven years. Not one of them ever moved. My hands are shaking.
A knife is no use against bare bone. I need something heavy, to break it.

walking_dead.title: A dead man
lines: A man is walking toward me out of the dark.
He has been dead a long time. I can see that from here, and I can smell it.
He should be lying in a coffin. He is on his feet, and he is coming for me.
I want to run. I do not know if a dead man can be killed a second time.

body.title: Bones
lines: There are human bones on the floor here. A skull, ribs, the long bones of the legs.
I have handled hundreds of skeletons in my work. It is different when I am shut in with one.
Whoever this was died down here, and nobody came for them.
I do not want to end the same way. There may be something useful lying with the bones.

water.title: Water
lines: The floor ends here, at the edge of black water.
My light does not reach the bottom. I cannot tell how deep it is.
There should be no water in a desert tomb. It must come up from somewhere far below.
I can swim, and I can hold my breath for about twenty seconds. If I go under, I must be sure I can come up again.

secret.title: A hidden room
lines: This room was hidden. From outside there was no sign of it at all.
The builders did not want anyone to find it.
If there is one hidden room, there will be others. From now on I will check the walls and the water.

hub_note.title: A note under a stone
lines: A page torn from a survey book, held down with a stone. The pencil is faint, but the writing is neat.
"To whoever comes after me. I am Oswin Teague, surveyor. I came down the well on the third day after the roof fell, with a lantern and not much else."
"I fell on these steps in the dark and my leg is broken. I can still hear the old man in the stone box to the north. He talks to me. I stopped answering."
"There are eight doors in this hall and eight sockets in the floor. I do not think they open by force. Take my pack. I have no use for it now. There is a tin of paraffin in it."
"Margaret, if this reaches you: I was not afraid at the end. I was only tired."
He is lying with his hand on the strap of the pack. I will take it, and I will not forget his name.
Eight doors, and the first to try is the temple of Ptah, in the north wall on the left. It is sealed. The old man to the north will open it. I will go to him first.
